_comment: Master configuration for Spatial Harp. Edit any value and refresh the browser to apply.

vision._comment: Camera resolution, landmark smoothing (0..1), and MediaPipe confidence thresholds (lower values keep half-screen hands tracked at frame edges).

pinch._comment: Thumb-to-index 3D distance thresholds for starting a pinch (pinchThreshold) and releasing it (releaseThreshold).

strings._comment: Mid-air string creation rules, 3-layer anti-snag endpoint tip grabbing (hitbox radius, firm pinch distance, hold dwell time, max hand speed), and laser color palette.

plucking._comment: Finger-to-string collision sensitivity, hysteresis release radius (prevents auto-plucking when holding multiple fingers on a string), and unplayable dead-zone margin around string tips.

audio._comment: Default synthesizer preset ('harp' | 'laser' | 'chime' | 'retro8bit'), musical scale ('pentatonic' | 'minor' | 'hirajoshi' | 'major' | 'blues'), master volume/FX, and 3D length-to-pitch bounds.

visuals._comment: Hand skeleton joint sizing, fingertips-only & bone line toggles, laser beam thickness, ruler tick transparency, multi-crest sinusoidal rainbow wave physics, concentric echo contours, radial contact starburst rays, and fine glitter dust.

ui._comment: UI behavior toggles (e.g. whether to automatically open the 4-step tutorial modal when starting the experience).
